description: Calculate the monthly payment, total interest and payoff time for an auto, equipment or personal loan, with sales tax, trade-in, fees, 0% promotions, extra payments and a lump sum. Canonical page: https://convertit.pro/loan-calculator

apr.description: APR (%) — Annual percentage rate from 0 to 50. Enter 0 for a 0% promotion.

down.description: Down payment ($) — Cash paid up front. Leave blank for none.

extra.description: Extra monthly payment ($, optional) — Added to every payment to pay the loan off sooner.

fees.description: Fees financed ($) — Documentation, registration or origination fees added to the loan.

lump.description: One-time lump sum ($, optional) — A single extra payment, for example a bonus or tax refund.

lumpMonth.description: Lump-sum month (required with a lump sum) — Payment number the lump sum is paid with, such as 12.

price.description: Price ($) — Purchase price or amount borrowed before tax, fees and down payment.

taxRate.description: Sales tax rate (%) — Applied to price minus trade-in, never below zero. Enter 0 if none.

trade.description: Trade-in value ($) — Credit for a trade-in. Also reduces the amount taxed. Leave blank for none.

name: calculate_loan
title: Loan Calculator (Auto, Equipment & Personal)
